Apple___Apple_scab.organic: Apply sulfur or liquid copper sprays early in the season. Rake and destroy fallen leaves to reduce overwintering fungal spores.
Apple___Apple_scab.chemical: Spray fungicides containing Captan, Mancozeb, or Myclobutanil at regular intervals starting from bud break.
Apple___Apple_scab.prevention: Prune trees to improve air circulation and sunlight penetration. Plant scab-resistant apple cultivars.

Apple___Black_rot.organic: Prune out dead wood, mummified fruits, and cankers. Apply copper-based organic fungicides during the dormant period.
Apple___Black_rot.chemical: Use fungicides with active ingredients like Captan, Thiophanate-methyl, or Mancozeb.
Apple___Black_rot.prevention: Sanitize pruning tools between cuts. Keep orchard floors clean and destroy infected plant debris.

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.organic: Remove nearby cedar/juniper galls within a 1-mile radius if possible. Apply sulfur or neem oil sprays at pink bud stage.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.chemical: Apply Myclobutanil, Mancozeb, or Propiconazole fungicides starting at early bloom.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.prevention: Avoid planting susceptible apple trees near eastern red cedar trees. Select rust-resistant cultivars.

Apple___healthy.organic: Plant is vigorous and disease-free. Maintain regular compost and balanced organic mulching.
Apple___healthy.prevention: Continue regular monitoring, deep root watering, and annual winter pruning.

Blueberry___healthy.organic: Plant is healthy. Keep soil acidic (pH 4.5–5.5) using pine bark mulch and elemental sulfur.
Blueberry___healthy.prevention: Ensure good drainage and maintain consistent drip irrigation.

Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.organic: Spray potassium bicarbonate, diluted neem oil, or horticultural oils during the morning hours.
Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.chemical: Apply fungicides containing Myclobutanil, Triflumizole, or sulfur-based formulations.
Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.prevention: Prune canopies to increase airflow and avoid high-nitrogen fertilizers that cause dense, susceptible shoots.

Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy.organic: Foliage is completely healthy. Provide organic mulch and maintain proper soil moisture.
Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy.prevention: Inspect leaves regularly and practice sanitary dormant-season pruning.

Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.organic: Apply biological control agents like Bacillus subtilis and practice deep residue tillage.
Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.chemical: Apply strobilurin or triazole fungicides (e.g., Azoxystrobin, Pyraclostrobin, Propiconazole).
Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.prevention: Rotate crops with non-grass crops (such as soybeans) and plant resistant hybrids.

Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.organic: Encourage natural predatory insects and spray copper hydroxide formulations if pressure is mild.
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.chemical: Use foliar fungicides containing Azoxystrobin, Propiconazole, or Pyraclostrobin.
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.prevention: Plant rust-resistant corn varieties and ensure early planting to avoid peak spore dispersal.

Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.organic: Incorporate crop residue into the soil after harvest and apply copper fungicides if detected early.
Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.chemical: Apply systemic fungicides like Pyraclostrobin, Mancozeb, or Difenoconazole.
Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.prevention: Utilize 1-2 year crop rotation and select corn hybrids possessing the Ht-resistance gene.

Corn_(maize)___healthy.organic: Crops are thriving. Maintain balanced N-P-K fertilization and adequate irrigation.
Corn_(maize)___healthy.prevention: Perform regular field scouting and weed control.

Grape___Black_rot.organic: Remove and bury infected mummified berries. Spray copper-soap fungicides from bud break through veraison.
Grape___Black_rot.chemical: Apply fungicides such as Mancozeb, Myclobutanil, or Captan starting at early shoot growth.
Grape___Black_rot.prevention: Train vines on trellises to maximize canopy aeration and sunlight exposure.

Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).organic: Prune infected cordons during dry weather and seal pruning wounds with organic wound sealant paste.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).chemical: Apply systemic fungicides like Fosetyl-Aluminium or paint wound surfaces with Thiophanate-methyl.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).prevention: Avoid heavy pruning during wet seasons and sanitize cutting shears with alcohol.

Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.organic: Spray Bordeaux mixture or copper sulfate solution in early spring.
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.chemical: Use broad-spectrum protective fungicides such as Mancozeb, Chlorothalonil, or Carbendazim.
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.prevention: Collect and burn fallen leaves to prevent the pathogen from overwintering.

Grape___healthy.organic: Vines are strong and clean. Apply organic compost to the root zone.
Grape___healthy.prevention: Continue canopy management and avoid overhead sprinkler watering.

Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).organic: Release parasitic wasps (Tamarixia radiata) to suppress Asian citrus psyllid populations. Apply foliar micronutrient sprays.
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).chemical: Control psyllid vectors using systemic insecticides like Imidacloprid, Thiamethoxam, or Chlorpyrifos.
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).prevention: Plant only certified disease-free nursery stock and eradicate infected trees promptly to prevent field spread.

Peach___Bacterial_spot.organic: Apply preventive fixed copper sprays during late dormancy before bud swell.
Peach___Bacterial_spot.chemical: Spray low rates of copper mixed with oxytetracycline antibiotic during the growing season.
Peach___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Plant resistant cultivars, avoid excessive nitrogen applications, and establish windbreaks.

Peach___healthy.organic: Tree is healthy. Maintain tree mulch and adequate seasonal watering.
Peach___healthy.prevention: Perform dormant sprays to prevent peach leaf curl and monitor foliage weekly.

Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.organic: Spray copper-based bactericides combined with Bacillus amyloliquefaciens.
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.chemical: Apply copper sulfate tank-mixed with Mancozeb to enhance bacterial suppression.
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Use certified pathogen-free seeds, practice drip irrigation, and avoid handling plants when foliage is wet.

Pepper,_bell___healthy.organic: Foliage is clear and green. Support plants with stakes and organic liquid seaweed fertilizer.
Pepper,_bell___healthy.prevention: Maintain soil moisture balance and inspect the underside of leaves for early pest activity.

Potato___Early_blight.organic: Apply copper octanoate or biofungicides containing Bacillus subtilis. Prune lower affected leaves.
Potato___Early_blight.chemical: Spray fungicides containing Chlorothalonil, Mancozeb, Azoxystrobin, or Difenoconazole.
Potato___Early_blight.prevention: Practice a 3-year crop rotation with non-solanaceous crops and avoid overhead irrigation.

Potato___Late_blight.organic: Destroy infected tubers immediately. Apply preventive copper hydroxide sprays before humid weather.
Potato___Late_blight.chemical: Use targeted systemic fungicides such as Metalaxyl, Dimethomorph, Cymoxanil, or Fluopicolide.
Potato___Late_blight.prevention: Hill up soil around plants to protect developing tubers from washing spores.

Potato___healthy.organic: Tuber canopy is in optimal condition. Maintain soil moisture and light mulching.
Potato___healthy.prevention: Ensure good soil drainage and continue scout checks for Colorado potato beetles and aphids.

Raspberry___healthy.organic: Canes are healthy. Mulch with wood chips and feed with well-rotted manure.
Raspberry___healthy.prevention: Prune out spent floricanes after fruiting to promote sunlight and air movement.

Soybean___healthy.organic: Crop shows vigorous vegetative growth. Ensure good nodulation with Rhizobium bacteria.
Soybean___healthy.prevention: Maintain integrated weed management and scout for soybean aphids.

Squash___Powdery_mildew.organic: Spray solutions of potassium bicarbonate, sulfur, or milk-water mixture (1:9 ratio) under sunlight.
Squash___Powdery_mildew.chemical: Apply systemic fungicides containing Myclobutanil, Boscalid, or Quinoxyfen.
Squash___Powdery_mildew.prevention: Select mildew-resistant varieties and maintain wide plant spacing for airflow.

Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.organic: Remove and discard diseased leaves after harvest. Spray copper soap fungicides before bloom.
Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.chemical: Apply fungicides such as Captan, Dodine, or Pyraclostrobin.
Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.prevention: Renovate strawberry beds after harvest, remove old runner leaves, and avoid overhead sprinkler systems.

Strawberry___healthy.organic: Plants are robust and productive. Provide pine needle mulch to keep berries off damp soil.
Strawberry___healthy.prevention: Water at the crown base using drip lines and thin overcrowded runners.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.organic: Apply copper-based organic formulations mixed with microbial sprays (Bacillus subtilis).
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.chemical: Spray copper hydroxide tank-mixed with Mancozeb for improved bacterial control.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Disinfect garden stakes and cages. Never work among plants when foliage is wet from rain or dew.

Tomato___Early_blight.organic: Strip lower leaves touching soil. Apply organic copper fungicide or neem-based antifungal solutions.
Tomato___Early_blight.chemical: Apply fungicides containing Chlorothalonil, Mancozeb, Azoxystrobin, or Difenoconazole.
Tomato___Early_blight.prevention: Mulch the soil surface beneath plants to stop soil-borne fungal spores from splashing onto leaves.

Tomato___Late_blight.organic: Remove and seal heavily infected plants in bags. Apply preventive copper spray during cool, damp weather.
Tomato___Late_blight.chemical: Apply targeted oomycete fungicides such as Metalaxyl-M, Dimethomorph, Cyazofamid, or Mancozeb.
Tomato___Late_blight.prevention: Ensure maximum spacing between plants and eliminate volunteer tomato and potato plants.

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.organic: Apply sulfur or copper fungicides. Ensure strong greenhouse ventilation and lower indoor humidity below 80%.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.chemical: Use protective fungicides such as Chlorothalonil, Thiophanate-methyl, or Mancozeb.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.prevention: Prune excess suckers to facilitate air flow and avoid overhead spraying inside tunnels/greenhouses.

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.organic: Prune out spotted bottom leaves immediately. Spray biofungicides or copper sulfate compounds.
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.chemical: Spray preventative fungicides like Chlorothalonil, Mancozeb, or Quadris (Azoxystrobin).
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.prevention: Rotate tomato beds every 2 to 3 years and use ground cloth/mulch to block soil splash.

Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.organic: Spray insecticidal soap, rosemary oil extract, or neem oil directly under the leaves. Introduce predatory mites (Phytoseiulus persimilis).
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.chemical: Apply targeted miticides/acaricides such as Abamectin, Bifenazate, or Spiromesifen.
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.prevention: Keep plants well-watered to prevent heat/drought stress and hose down dust around garden perimeters.

Tomato___Target_Spot.organic: Apply copper-based fungicides and prune crowded inner branches to allow light penetration.
Tomato___Target_Spot.chemical: Spray fungicides formulated with Chlorothalonil, Azoxystrobin, or Famoxadone.
Tomato___Target_Spot.prevention: Keep plants staked upright and ensure leaves dry quickly following rainfall.

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.organic: Control silverleaf whitefly vectors using yellow sticky cards, insecticidal soaps, or reflective silver mulch.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.chemical: Apply systemic insecticides like Imidacloprid, Acetamiprid, or Dinotefuran to control whiteflies.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.prevention: Install fine mesh netting in greenhouses and plant TYLCV-resistant hybrid tomato seed varieties.

Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.organic: There is no cure once infected; carefully dig up and destroy diseased plants to protect healthy ones.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.chemical: Chemical fungicides and virucides are ineffective against plant viruses.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.prevention: Wash hands with milk or soap before touching plants (especially after tobacco use). Disinfect tools with a 10% bleach solution.

Tomato___healthy.organic: Plant is thriving. Support vigorous vine growth with compost tea and organic calcium supplements.
Tomato___healthy.prevention: Maintain regular watering to prevent blossom end rot and prune suckers for optimal fruiting.
